title: Cibola Burn
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: The fourth Expanse novel. Humanity can now travel to hundreds of new worlds, and the first settlers on one are in a standoff with a corporate expedition that holds a legal claim. A familiar crew is sent to calm things down.
readIf: you like space opera that treats a colony frontier as a conflict between people, not just monsters.
skipIf: you want to jump in cold, since the main characters and their history need earlier books.

pairings.reason: Shares the pleasure of clever people solving hard survival problems on a hostile world.
Another story about settling a new planet that turns out to be less empty than expected.
A stranger and more unsettling look at an alien landscape and the people sent to survey it.
